title: Review Minggu 8
topic: Review: listening kampus dan percakapan minggu 8
objectives: Meninjau ulang dialog, tanggapan, dan saran
Meninjau ulang idiom, makna kiasan, dan kata yang tidak biasa
Meninjau ulang metode, tenggat, dan percakapan kampus

block1.tip: Saat mengulang, tanyakan tiga hal: siapa yang bicara, apa tenggatnya, dan apa tindakan yang disarankan. Jawaban sering ada di sana.

youtube.videoDescription: Video 10 sampai 15 menit yang merangkum dialog, idiom, percakapan kampus, dan pidato akademik dari minggu 8.

lesson.intro: Minggu 8 membahas dialog pendek, sinonim, idiom, ekspresi negatif, percakapan kampus, dan pidato akademik. Sesi review ini menyatukan semuanya dalam satu percakapan.

sections.heading: Dialog dan tanggapan
sections.bodyMd: Dalam **dialogue**, pembicara kedua memberi **reply** atau **response**. Jika dia memberi **suggestion**, jawabannya sering berupa saran itu.

sections.heading: Idiom dan kiasan
sections.bodyMd: Sebuah **idiom** sering **figurative**, artinya maknanya tidak sama dengan kata-katanya. Jangan mengartikan idiom kata demi kata.

sections.heading: Kampus dan penelitian
sections.bodyMd: Di **campus**, perhatikan **deadline**. Dalam **research**, **method** menjelaskan cara penelitian. Jika sebuah permintaan **unlikely**, kemungkinan besar jawabannya tidak.

formulas.label: Kemungkinan

lines.speaker: Student A
lines.text: Let's review week eight before the simulation. Can you give me an example of a dialogue where the second speaker makes a suggestion?

lines.speaker: Student B
lines.text: Sure. When one student asks for a deadline change, the second speaker might reply with a suggestion to talk to the lecturer.

lines.speaker: Student A
lines.text: Good. What about an alternative? Is there a rule for using it?

lines.speaker: Student B
lines.text: An alternative is a different option. If the library is closed, the alternative is the campus study room.

lines.speaker: Student A
lines.text: And what about the idiom? I always mix up literal and figurative meaning.

lines.speaker: Student B
lines.text: Break a leg is figurative. It means good luck, not a real injury.

lines.speaker: Student A
lines.text: Okay. A deadline change is usually unlikely, right?

lines.speaker: Student B
lines.text: Yes. Deadlines are usually fixed. A staff member would probably refuse an unlikely request.

lines.speaker: Student A
lines.text: For the research part, what is the method in a study?

lines.speaker: Student B
lines.text: The method is the step-by-step plan. The research team uses it to test a hypothesis.

lines.speaker: Student A
lines.text: Thanks. I will reply to the feedback email tonight.

Pada research, tekanan ada di suku kedua: ri-SURCH.
Pada figurative, tekanan ada di suku pertama: FIG-yer-uh-tiv.
